text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while taking photos of the Umamusume
racing to use as reference materials for training……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is it just my imagination? For some reason,
it feels like one particular Umamusume keeps photobombing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While taking photos on another day...
choice_data_list: Aren't you the one from the other day—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you noticed me.
A momentary lapse on Machan's part.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Machan just can't help it... whenever there's a camera around, she gets all antsy...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I simply find myself photobombing――driven by the urge
to leave a bit of Machan in everyone's hands,
so I can't help but step into frame.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
――Oh-ho, speak of the devil and a photobomb opportunity appears.
Well then, well then, off I go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Street photobombing, what in the world...? Does she just like being photographed?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night, while sorting through the photos I took――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan is in every single photo
I've ever taken...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On another day, I set up my camera again.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, we meet again.
It's the world's most coincidental Machan.
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well now, whatever could it be?
choice_data_list: Why not try modeling for some photos?
I want to know the secret to your photobombing mastery.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: My, a passionate modeling offer? Machan is deeply touched.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that I was looking for an Umamusume
who would let me record her running for training materials.
choice_data_list: They seem to like getting their picture taken...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I would be delighted to accept.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Machan just likes... leaving something behind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Aston Machan, I was able to complete the training materials ahead of schedule.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hoho, so you seek instruction from Machan,
the roving snapshot artist...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, very well.
The Machan Dojo is officially open.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In return――make sure you remember this
loud and clear when you head back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Understood? First off, the key is
*pitter-patter*. Not *whoooosh*.
It is *pitter-patter*.
